name: Tidemark HR
blurb: Tidemark HR (fictional) sells payroll and HR software to mid-size employers.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.text: The Information Security Program establishes the administrative, technical and physical safeguards that Tidemark HR maintains to protect Customer Data.

sections.heading: 2. Governance
sections.text: The Chief Information Security Officer is accountable for the Program. The Program is reviewed annually by the Security Steering Committee.

sections.heading: 3. Encryption of Stored Data
sections.text: Tidemark HR shall encrypt all Customer Data at rest using AES-256 or stronger, including databases, file stores, backups and search indexes.

sections.heading: 4. Encryption of Data in Transit
sections.text: Tidemark HR does not encrypt data in transit. The platform and its integrations communicate over unencrypted connections.

sections.heading: 5. Customer-Managed Encryption Keys
sections.text: Tidemark HR supports customer-managed encryption keys (BYOK). Customers retain control of key rotation and revocation through their own key management service.

sections.heading: 6. Customer Audit Logging
sections.text: An audit trail of administrator actions is available to customers. End-user activity is not included in the customer-facing audit trail.

sections.heading: 7. Security Event Logging
sections.text: Security event logs shall be centralized in the SIEM and retained for a minimum of twelve months, with alerting monitored 24x7.

sections.heading: 8. Vulnerability Management
sections.text: Authenticated vulnerability scans of all production assets shall be performed at least monthly. Critical vulnerabilities shall be remediated within 15 days.

sections.heading: 9. Secure Development
sections.text: All changes to production code shall be peer reviewed and approved prior to deployment, and static analysis shall be executed in the build pipeline.

sections.heading: 1. Applicability
sections.text: This Standard applies to all workforce members and to all systems that store or process Customer Data.

sections.heading: 5. Automated Provisioning
sections.text: The platform supports SCIM 2.0 for automated user provisioning and deprovisioning from the customer's identity provider.

sections.heading: 7. Termination of Access
sections.text: Tidemark HR does not define a timeframe for revoking access upon termination.

sections.heading: 1. Objective
sections.text: This Procedure defines the phases of incident handling: identification, containment, eradication, recovery and post-incident review.

sections.heading: 2. Incident Response Program
sections.text: Tidemark HR maintains a documented incident response program with defined roles, severity classifications and escalation paths, approved by the CISO.

sections.heading: 5. Customer Notification
sections.text: Affected customers are notified of a confirmed breach of Customer Data within the timeframe required by applicable law. No fixed contractual timeframe is defined.

sections.heading: 6. Testing
sections.text: The incident response program shall be tested at least annually through a tabletop exercise, with lessons learned documented.

sections.heading: 1. Objective
sections.text: This Plan defines how Tidemark HR maintains availability of the payroll platform and restores operations after a disruption.

sections.heading: 3. Data Backup
sections.text: Customer Data shall be backed up daily, with backups retained for 30 days and replicated to a geographically separate region.

sections.heading: 4. Backup Protection
sections.text: Database backups are encrypted. Document archive backups are stored unencrypted on tape.

sections.heading: 5. Disaster Recovery Testing
sections.text: Backup restoration is tested quarterly. A full failover test of the disaster recovery plan has not been performed.

sections.heading: 6. Geographic Redundancy
sections.text: The platform is deployed across multiple geographically separate regions with automated failover.

sections.heading: 1. Objective
sections.text: This Policy governs the selection, onboarding and ongoing oversight of third parties that access Customer Data.

sections.heading: 3. Due Diligence
sections.text: Third parties undergo a security risk assessment prior to onboarding. Periodic reassessment is not currently performed.

sections.heading: 4. Subprocessors
sections.text: Tidemark HR maintains a public list of subprocessors and provides customers 30 days' notice of any new subprocessor.

sections.heading: 1. Objective
sections.text: This Schedule defines retention periods for categories of records held by Tidemark HR.

sections.heading: 3. Disposal upon Termination
sections.text: Upon termination, Customer Data shall be deleted from production systems within 30 days and from backups within 90 days, and a certificate of deletion is available upon request.

sections.heading: 1. Applicability
sections.text: This Standard applies to employees, contractors and temporary staff of Tidemark HR.

sections.heading: 3. Security Awareness Training
sections.text: Tidemark HR does not provide security awareness training to its workforce.

sections.heading: 4. Pre-Employment Screening
sections.text: Background checks are performed on employees prior to hire. Contractors are not screened.

sections.heading: 1. Overview
sections.text: Tidemark HR maintains independent attestations, which are available to customers and prospects upon execution of a non-disclosure agreement.

sections.heading: 3. Penetration Testing
sections.text: An independent third party performs a penetration test of the platform at least annually. An executive summary is available under NDA.

sections.heading: 4. SOC 2
sections.text: Tidemark HR maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation covering the Security and Availability criteria, renewed annually.

sections.heading: 5. ISO/IEC 27001
sections.text: Tidemark HR does not hold ISO/IEC 27001 certification.

sections.heading: Note
sections.text: This overview was prepared for the sales team and has not been updated since the 2022 platform migration.

sections.heading: 2. Incident Response Program
sections.text: Tidemark HR does not maintain a documented incident response program.

sections.heading: 6. Geographic Redundancy
sections.text: The platform is hosted in a single region without geographic redundancy.

sections.heading: 4. Subprocessors
sections.text: Tidemark HR does not maintain a customer-facing list of subprocessors.
